title: Choose next READY capability and materialize its bounded wave
goal: Run the canonical reuse-first-v1 readiness and wave-selection compilers after E10-SCALE-006A; inspect the selected canonical capability and decompose it into bounded, secure and verifiable implementation tasks without prematurely writing product runtime.
inputs: VERIFIED E10-SCALE-006A ledger and readiness evidence
canonical Product Spec of selected READY capability
explicit capability boundary ownership and current OPEN decision set
outputs: one bounded implementation wave and manifests
first executable READY child and dependency-gated successors
invariants: no product runtime code is written by this selection task
selection must be computed, never assumed as CAP-INV-101 or prior wave
every selected capability source must be validated before decomposition
OPEN decisions and boundary ownership enforced fail closed
security_properties: deny cross-tenant permission leaks and unverified capability selection
no third-party runtime functionality without explicit trusted-base decision
split oversized work units before implementation
acceptance_tests: wave selection matches READY and reuse-first policy
new manifests pass strict-v2 schema and complexity budgets
one first child READY, others dependency-blocked

performance_budget.rationale: control-plane decomposition only; runtime budgets are compiled in the selected capability child work

migration.rationale: no product runtime or persistent data is changed

verification: verified Case Queue ledger entry and product runtimes unchanged

definition_of_ready: fresh capability readiness and wave selection available
definition_of_done: next canonical capability selected from READY set
bounded child manifests and dependency graph committed
one first implementation child is READY
